svg.text: The teacher’s path — seven screens, and nothing else
The whole product as she experiences it. Every line below is wording the surface actually renders — the words are the interface, and there is nothing behind them to learn.
Nothing pending — the default, and the goal
All 16 exams from Midterm 1 are in the gradebook, and your students
can see their feedback. When something needs your decision, it will
Photos or PDFs, as many as you like. You never have to rename a
file on your computer — you can type each name on this page.
Last sent this morning — 16 exams, Midterm 1.
The screen she should see on almost every day of the term.
Files arriving — the two questions she is asked
Two files look like one exam
One exam — I’ll send them as one PDF
These came from a camera, so we
The only work the system asks of her — and only when the camera named the file.
Grading in progress — in plain counts
This page keeps itself up to date. You can close it and come back
Counts, not stages. There is no job to watch and no progress to interpret.
only when something was held — on a clean batch screen 4 never appears, and she goes straight to 6
The fork — two groups, two ways out
a bigger day than the one above: 100 students, and the precaution
rule tripped across the whole batch
Almost all of them are fine. They are in two
separate groups, settled in two different ways.
Something on these pages the system will not
decide on its own. You look at them one at a time.
Review these one at a time
Nothing was found wrong with these — they were
held only because they arrived with the rest.
No exam with a reason of its own can leave in the bulk release.
The ones that need judgement — one at a time
Stop for now — the rest keep waiting
This scan is blurry — please confirm
The grader read this from the page:
Put it in the gradebook A
I’ll grade this one myself S
Every exam is in the gradebook and
your students can see their feedback.
There is nothing left waiting for you.
Mathematics · Midterm 1 · in the gradebook 4 min ago
Where a parent’s question gets answered.
the sixty leave together on one confirmation — they never pass through screen 5
job ids · stage names (fetch, grade, audit, risk, sync, verify, optimize) · confidence numbers and the 0.85 gate · model names · prompt versions · trace ids · checkpoint state

quarantine ratios and the 15 % circuit breaker · dead-letter entries · token counts and cost. Everything the other two diagrams describe happens without her, and none of its vocabulary reaches this surface.
Wording from the shipped teacher surface · the triage claim from implementation 013 · Camila’s reason, quoted line and marks from the measured runs.
